answer.text: For checking the battery voltage, the manual says to contact a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre or a battery service centre.
On the analog screen, the battery gauge has four segments, and each segment represents 1 V.

policy.text: For checking the battery voltage, the manual directs the rider to an authorised service centre.

watchouts.text: Holding the starter button down for long periods can drain the battery below the 10 V threshold.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not describe a way for the rider to measure the battery voltage.
The gauge segments show approximate levels only, and the manual gives them as examples.

watchout_review.reason: Warning covers disconnecting battery cables during removal, not checking voltage.
